data.desc: Inogen, Inc. (Nasdaq: INGN) is a medical technology company offering innovative respiratory products for use in the homecare setting. Inogen supports patient respiratory care by developing, manufacturing, and marketing innovative respiratory therapy devices used to deliver care to patients suffering from chronic respiratory conditions. Inogen partners with patients, prescribers, home medical equipment providers and distributors to make its respiratory therapy products widely available, allowing patients the chance to manage the impact of their disease.
